steps.title: Conclude
steps.body: $w(u,v)\ge65-53=12$. Equality is possible (edge on the shortest path to v), so strict $>$ is not guaranteed.

w can be any value ≥ 12, e.g. 100, so ≤ 12 is not always true.

steps.title: Release both
steps.body: Changing to $11$ (hold) at the same instant: both NANDs see 1,1 and try to go to 0 together, then both back to 1… With identical delays this repeats — oscillation (metastability).

01 then 10: a clean set/reset — stable.
